Overview

Tomsk is a city in Tomsk Oblast with a population of 570,000. Siberia’s oldest scientific and educational center, a historic city with well-preserved wooden architecture and top universities. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
